hypotheses.oneSentenceStory: Review combined partner reward balances and transfer options using clear, jargon-free plain English.
hypotheses.customerSituation: The customer holds balances across three separate partner programmes and wants to view them together without complex terminology.
hypotheses.storyTension: Complex technical jargon and fragmented balances make it difficult to understand how points move between partner programmes.
hypotheses.customerResolution: A unified, jargon-free rewards overview clearly presents combined balances and straightforward portability options.
hypotheses.primaryOutcome: Effortless understanding of multi-partner reward balances and clear, jargon-free portability options.

hypotheses.oneSentenceStory: Check ongoing progress toward the Family Holiday Fund savings goal.
hypotheses.customerSituation: The customer is actively tracking a Family Holiday Fund savings goal with established progress.
hypotheses.storyTension: Uncertainty regarding how accumulated rewards contribute toward the active savings target.
hypotheses.customerResolution: Clear display of goal progress connecting available rewards directly to the Family Holiday Fund.
hypotheses.primaryOutcome: Clear visibility of goal progression and contribution of rewards.
